package.description: SharpKeys is a Registry hack that is used to make certain keys on a keyboard act like other keys.

en-US.description: SharpKeys is a Registry hack that is used to make certain keys on a keyboard act like other keys.
en-US.longDescription:
SharpKeys is a utility that manages a Registry key that allows Windows to remap one key to any other key.
Included in the application is a list of common keyboard keys and a Type Key feature to automatically recognize most keyboard keys.
en-US.name: SharpKeys
